MemberPlanMedicationStmt.name: MemberPlanMedicationStmt
MemberPlanMedicationStmt.description: Represents a junction between member plans and medication statements. It associates the medications that a patient is currently taking or has taken in the past with their health plan coverage.

LastReferencedDate.description: The most recent date on which a user referenced this record.

LastViewedDate.description: The most recent date on which a user viewed this record.

MedicationStatementId.description: The medication statement associated with the member plan.

MemberPlanId.description: The parent member plan associated with the medication statement.
